title: Warm Roasted Tunisian Vegetable Tagine
description: A hearty, roasted Tunisian dish featuring a mix of vegetables and rice wine, perfect for a lazy Sunday. This ovo-vegetarian friendly tagine is infused with aromatic oils and spices.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, rice wine, vegetable broth, and tomato paste.
Add the chopped onions, sliced bell peppers, cubed eggplant, and sliced zucchini to the bowl and toss to coat with the oil mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the vegetable mixture to a large baking dish and roast in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
While the vegetables are roasting, cook the couscous according to package instructions.
After the vegetables have roasted for 30 minutes, create 4 wells in the vegetable mixture and crack an egg into each well.
Return the baking dish to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the eggs are cooked to desired doneness.
Serve the roasted vegetables and eggs over the cooked couscous.
